title: Midnight Train Blues
tuning: E A D G B E
learningGoal: Independent alternating quarter-note thumb bass with syncopated melodic phrases, rests and a resolved blues ending
practiceInstructions: Standard tuning; right hand p for bass, i/m/a for melody; no pick or percussion. Start at 60 BPM, count 1-and-2-and-3-and-4-and, then grow to 88 BPM. Hold the 12th-bar E melody for four beats over the bass.
successCriteria: Four even quarter-note bass attacks in each bar
Treble syncopations and intentional rests preserved
Final sustained E over E7 bass at bar 12
